title: Natural bridge from module right-derived sections to source ordinary H
statement: For every scheme X and nonnegative degree q, module right-derived global sections [pqf-def-cohomology] admit additive equivalences to Scheme.Modules.H(F,q), simultaneously for all O_X-modules F and natural for every module morphism. The source H model is Ext from the constant integer sheaf to the underlying Zariski abelian sheaf. No quasi-coherence or geometric finiteness is required.

source.place: Tag 03FD, Lemma 21.12.4; free-abelian representable at the terminal open and constant integer sheaf.

proof.text: Apply zariskiModuleAbelianCohomologyAgree in degree q to get the natural comparison with H-prime evaluated at the top open.

Every Hom(U,top) is a singleton. FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv followed by inverse AddEquiv.ulift gives an additive presheaf isomorphism from free abelian Yoneda at top to the constant lifted integers. Naturality is checked on generators. Sheafify this isomorphism and precompose Ext with its inverse using Ext.precompAddEquiv.

Evaluate the naturality square of the module/abelian comparison on x. Ext associativity in which the last morphism has degree zero proves that precomposition by the source isomorphism commutes with postcomposition by the underlying module morphism. This proves the stated naturality, including q=0, zero modules and empty X.

theorem exists_moduleCohomology_source_comparison (X : Scheme.{u}) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : ∀ F : X.Modules,
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj F) ≃+ H F q,
      ∀ (F G : X.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ G)
          (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj F),
        e G (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).map φ).hom x) =
          H.map φ q (e F x)
